revision_reason: Pre-formal v10.1 correction: replace the legacy answer-status wording, make assessment_guidance authoritative over non-conjunctive required-information dimensions, and require a retained 16-attempt live development gate before final freeze.
purpose: A strictly matched comparator that isolates bounded LangGraph routing from direct prompt-only action selection.

allowed_difference.mvp: The model makes a provisional Protocol-coverage check and words a graph-approved follow-up; LangGraph selects and enforces the bounded action.
allowed_difference.prompt_only_baseline: A versioned prompt directly returns the provisional Protocol-coverage assessment, participant control, selected action, covered and missing information, short audit reason, and participant-facing response through a lightweight adapter.

coverage_interpretation.required_information_role: Researcher-defined dimensions to inspect; they are conjunctive only when assessment_guidance explicitly requires every dimension.
coverage_interpretation.extra_detail_rule: Do not ask a follow-up merely because additional optional detail could be useful.

raw_output_rule: Store the raw model response before parsing; store parsed output separately; export parse failures without replacing or repairing them.
failure_rule: Every attempted run receives a new run_id and is retained even when execution, parsing, validation, or metric calculation fails.

development_gate.pass_rule: All 16 exact scheduled attempts complete and independently validate PASS.
